profile.headline: Senior Software Developer Team Lead at California Department of Public Health
profile.summary: Experienced Project Lead Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the medical practice industry. Skilled in Search Engine Optimization (SEO), PHP, Javascript, Full Stack, Laravel, Vue, and many other tools.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
Designed. developed, integrated and tested new features into complex existing code-base.
Integrated third party api's creating sdk’s when needed (Authnet CIM/ARB/SIM, Biosigns, GatewayEDI, EligibleApi, Fuze, Zoom, etc.)
Integrated multiple audio/video/data packages (Fuze, Vsee, AMD)
Mentored new developers in coding standards, design methods, and business logic.
Performed multiple security audits to identify and classify security issues, prioritized, and created appropriate patches and security measures to fix/minify issues.
Implemented security and performance improvements on servers implementing load balancing, autoscaling, encryption, backups and deployment procedures.

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
Developed multiple features using PHP 5.4, Zend MVC framework, Doctrine ORM, DQL and MySQL, Smarty templating, HTML5 and CSS3
Worked with direct supervision on some features, and independently on most features.
“hit the ground running, caught up to speed on technology you weren't familiar with, and are able to dig into the code and figure things out.” -- Justin Osterholt (Lead Developer - e.Republic)

positions.title: Drupal Developer
positions.description:
Develop and administer Amazon EC2 cloud-based Drupal and PHP 5.3-5.4 websites using HTML5, MySQL, CSS3, and Jquery.
Implemented automated backup and security update based on cron and Drush
Migrated sites to install profiles for Aegir application deployment
Performed site upgrades to Drupal 7

positions.title: Webstaff
positions.description:
Develop and update websites for multiple clients integrating ecommerce and CMS functionality using PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and Jquery.
Responsible for ongoing management and troubleshooting of ISP's production *nix mail and web server environment (primarily Apache & FreeBSD)
Custom software applications to facilitate troubleshooting by our technical support agents.

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description: Responsible for re-factoring and upgrading client websites to separate concerns – making it possible to extend and upgrade a large application's business rules while also enabling interface enhancement.

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
Developed custom SEO-savvy MySQL and XML-driven content management systems.
Built multi-site XML-RPC distributed content publishing and management system providing centralized control of content including tracking and aggregation of search-oriented statistics. Designed to scale up to several thousand content consumers without significant increased load on primary server.
Upgraded and expanded central content administration interface, implementing AJAX and transition from Windows-client based software to PHP/JavaScript web-based interface.
Designed and implemented scraping tools in PERL to gather statistical data from several thousand websites to feed into an XML engine for analysis.
Developed financial tracking application using C#.NET, IIS, and MSSQL.
